model_annotation:
The figure shows the inconsistent degree of target prediction probability distribution before and after speech enhancement in the MuST-C English-German and German-English training process.

The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 0 to 30, representing the number of iterations, with each tick mark representing an interval of 5.

The y-axis is labeled with values from 0 to 1.2, representing the inconsistent degree, with each tick mark representing an interval of 0.2.

There are two lines on the graph. The blue line starts at approximately (0, 1.2) and decreases sharply to approximately (5, 0.6), then gradually decreases to approximately (30, 0.45). The orange line starts at approximately (0, 1.1) and decreases sharply to approximately (5, 0.55), then gradually decreases to approximately (30, 0.45).
